g.text: Discovery failure prediction: fixed capacity and oracle-access controls

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #444444

g.text: Inputs: 19 additive source features; 25 fixed interactions give 44 total. Source-oracle tiers add value, magnitude and sign.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #444444

g.text: Hatched tiers require an oracle. Neutral tiers use at most one extra query; reference gold is additional access, not a target LM response.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #444444

g.text: ‡ Last tier adds no observation beyond source oracle + raw neutral above it; only the deterministic failure encoding changes.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #444444

g.text: Mean-OOF ensemble: fixed seeds 17, 29 and 43; 24 consumed discovery components. Partition seeds are not independent replications.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #444444

g.text: Scores compare predictors within each checkpoint. No mechanism C or untouched final-test claim; conditional intervals are in the full report.
